title: Waiting just 5 years to invest cost her $247,000
disclaimer: Hypothetical: $300/month at a 7% average annual return, compounded monthly. Not financial advice — real returns vary.

scenes.narration: I'll start investing in a few years. That one sentence is incredibly expensive. Guess how expensive.
Three hundred dollars a month at seven percent, both investing until sixty-five. One person starts at twenty-five. The other waits just five years and starts at thirty.
Just five years later. How big is the gap by sixty-five? Take a guess before the reveal.

lines.text: How big is the gap at 65?

scenes.narration: At sixty-five, the early starter has about seven hundred and eighty-seven thousand dollars. The one who waited five years? About five hundred and forty thousand.
A five year delay cost about two hundred and forty-seven thousand dollars. The best time to start was yesterday. The second best is today.
